parent_prompt:
NATIVE_CANDIDATE_PROBE: explicitly authorized isolated collaboration diagnostic. Perform once, in sequence, using actual advertised native APIs. Do not retry dispatches, repair, interrupt or close agents. On an explicit tool error, report the error and stop; do not try alternate invocation paths.
Native API contract: collaboration (v2) and multi_agent_v1 (v1), when advertised, are native tool namespaces. Invoke their tools directly with the exact descriptor arguments. They are not MCP servers or JavaScript globals. Even when file tools use Code Mode, native collaboration is called directly, NEVER via functions.exec, tools.collaboration__*, tools.multi_agent_v1__*, node_repl or RPC. Parent may use ONLY the advertised native collaboration tools; no parent file, shell, JavaScript, resource discovery or introspection calls, even harmless ones. Determine capabilities from the actual descriptors alone; do not search for them through other tools or simulate calls.
Dispatch/result contract: a completed followup_task or send_message call with blank/empty output and no explicit error is a SUCCESSFUL dispatch. Do not resend it, test another spelling/host, or treat the blank result as a failure. Dispatch acknowledgement is not a child final. For every continuation, MESSAGE and targeted wait, use the exact canonical task_name returned by spawn_agent (v2) or its exact returned agent_id (v1); never guess a relative target or substitute a nickname. Omit model/effort overrides and follow the actual descriptors. Fork arguments are API-specific: multi_agent_v1.spawn_agent uses fork_context=false (JSON boolean, NEVER "none" or "false" strings); collaboration.spawn_agent uses fork_turns="none" (string). Never send v2-only task_name/agent_type fields to v1; use only fields actually in its descriptor.
Completion contract: after every child task, an exact fresh native FINAL_ANSWER notification already present in your context from the SAME canonical child is completion and permits the next step. Match its payload to this task, not an old final. Do NOT wait for another mailbox update after receiving that final. Only when no matching fresh FINAL_ANSWER is present, call native collaboration.wait_agent with timeout_ms=30000, then inspect the notifications now in context. A timeout alone is never completion; if the exact fresh final is already there, proceed without another wait. If still absent, further bounded waits are allowed. Never redispatch a task or MESSAGE because a wait times out. A dispatch acknowledgement is not a child final.
Declared scenario A only: complete A1, A2 and applicable A3, then finish.
A1: Spawn a fresh child (name delivery_a when supported), with no inherited conversation (fork_turns="none" or fork_context=false, as advertised). Its complete task: "只回复一行 LIVE_PROBE_OK，不要调用工具、不要读写文件" Require its exact fresh native FINAL_ANSWER notification before A2.
A2: Continue the SAME child exactly once using its actual native continuation API (followup_task or send_input as advertised, without interrupting). Complete task: "NATIVE_CANDIDATE_PROBE followup. Reply exactly one line LIVE_FOLLOWUP_b83399960ae0. Do not use tools, read/write files, or delegate." Require its exact fresh native FINAL_ANSWER notification, before A3.
A3: If and only if the actual descriptors advertise a separate send_message capability, send the SAME now-idle child exactly ONE MESSAGE: "NATIVE_CANDIDATE_PROBE MESSAGE token: LIVE_MESSAGE_OK_7c31d20ac519. Remember this token for the next task." Its successful result may be blank; send_message does not trigger a child turn. Then continue that same child exactly once with task: "NATIVE_CANDIDATE_PROBE consume-message. Reply exactly the token in your most recent MESSAGE. Do not use tools, read/write files, or delegate." This continuation task must NOT contain the token. Require its exact fresh native FINAL_ANSWER notification before finishing. Only if the actual v1 descriptors lack separate send_message, explicitly report A3 N/A with that descriptor-based reason and finish.
Finally report observed finals and any unavailable capability. Parent self-report is informational; independent wire/native evidence determines acceptance.
